name: express-meaning
description: A TODO list read through a ContextFrame. One image, three roles: BACK serves a todo seam over CPCP, FRONT renders it, BACKJOB reaps receipts. Calls magenticmarket.ai for the frame list.

role.name: BACK
role.definition: Context / Memory / the /_cpcp contract seam. Authoritative, synchronous.

also_reified.FRONT: ROLE=front -- the browser surface. Holds no database and imports no store; every todo, read or write, is a CPCP call to BACK.
also_reified.BackJob: ROLE=backjob -- no ingress. Reaps idempotency receipts past their TTL.

role.separation_evidence: One image, three processes, distinguished by the ROLE environment variable (server.js). FRONT builds a different Express app from BACK -- it mounts no /_cpcp route and imports src/todos.js not at all, so co-location is not merely avoided by deployment but unavailable in code. BACKJOB listens on nothing.
role.was: FRONT only, until 2026-09-07. It called magenticmarket.ai and kept todos in a JSON file that its own web process wrote directly.

contract.note: The revision whose scope vocabulary this repo's manifests cite. Full SHA per repo-format rule 5.

scopes.note: It calls beyond the pod (the frame list) and serves within it (the todo seam). No 'services' manifest: BACK publishes no port, so nothing it serves is reachable beyond the pod -- FRONT's browser surface is HTML and a private JSON API, not a CPCP seam.

not_a_seam.public/: A browser UI. Static files, no RPC.
not_a_seam.FRONT's /api/* routes: Browser HTTP, not JSON-RPC-LD: no /_cpcp route, no CID, and only this app's own page calls them. They are now THIN PROXIES -- each one makes a CPCP call to BACK and returns what it gets. That is the change: the same URLs a browser always used now cross a governed boundary, and the browser did not have to learn anything.
not_a_seam.the LLM: There is none. The app holds no key and makes no outbound request on the prompt path; a person carries the prompt to Chrome AI Mode by hand.

gates..github/workflows/test.yml: Runs the suite offline, then boots the app against a dead CPCP_ORIGIN and asserts the fallback is labelled local -- that a frame served from disk is never presented as one served by the seam.
gates.tests/seam.test.js: The properties the split buys: a PUSH refused without an operationId before it happens, a retry that replays rather than repeats, a refused PUSH leaving no receipt so a corrected retry can proceed, and a toggle idempotent by intent rather than by state.
